feature_under_test: scheduled daily SourceOccurrence through paginated Listing materialization and production Detail response capture

environment.database_identity: ephemeral non-root staircase_runtime and staircase_migrator accounts

implementation.listing_dispatch: each accepted page creates at most one wake for each selected available executor of the derived Detail capability, never one wake per Job
implementation.batch_fallback: an empty initial Detail/Backfill batch leaves the dispatch pending and the same Executor falls back to the existing single-offer protocol for Listing; only a later empty continuation completes that continuation dispatch

correctness_assertions: Atoll durable daily timer creates exactly one immutable SourceOccurrence and one Listing Work
production HTTP Listing follows metadata offset pagination with at most 500 observations per page
the old activity boundary is reached before the incremental Checkpoint advances exactly once
every new observation creates exactly one Detail Work, successful Attempt, immutable JobDetailVersion, and response Artifact
every response Resource is read through Server and checked against its MySQL SHA-256 and byte count
all active Permits return to zero and every execution dispatch is delivered
all domain events due during execution are present in the Atoll Channel ledger
logical close at the immutable future window end reports one Listing success and every Detail success
the future-dated daily close event remains pending until its real delivery time instead of being delivered early
Server restart preserves DailyRun summary, executor presence, and response Resource readability

capacity_assessment.interpretation: the actual daily Listing-to-Detail path is now proven through a controlled 5,000-item peak and is faster than the prior Backfill proxy, but a single four-core host still misses the arithmetic 400K-in-8h reference
